Events.Title: Sand Golem at the Trailer Park
Events.Callout: Somebody at the Dust Devil Trailer Park forgot to leave a cup of water out. A Sand Golem is rising between the trailers.
Events.Success: The golem crumbles into a very expensive pile of sand. The residents start leaving water out again.
Events.Failure: The golem flattened the trailer park and walked back into the dunes.

Events.Title: Dune Wyrm Warning
Events.Callout: Truckers on the radio: something huge is moving under the sand. Stay on the rocks and cut your engine.
Events.Objective: Stay on the rocks, or try your luck with the bounty
Events.Success: The Dune Wyrm is dead. Every trucker on the canyon road owes you a drink.

Events.Title: Crashed Supply Truck
Events.Callout: A supply truck rolled off the desert road. Neon Jackals got there before the tow truck.
Events.Objective: Clear the jackals, then take the cargo
Events.Success: The cargo is yours. The jackals did not leave a review.

Events.Title: Sun Griffin Feather
Events.Callout: A gold feather is lying on the sand, warm as noon. Its owner is circling with the sun behind it.
Events.Objective: Grab the feather before the griffin dives
Events.Success: The feather is yours. It is warm in your hand for an hour.
Events.Failure: The Sun Griffin took its feather home.

Events.Title: Roadside Brawl
Events.Callout: Quartz Kings bikers and an Ember Court crew are arguing over a broken-down truck in the desert. With tyre irons.
Events.Success: Your side keeps the truck. It still doesn't run.

Events.Title: The Desert Prophet
Events.Callout: An old prospector is sitting on a rock in the middle of nowhere, talking to the horizon.
Events.Name: Old Man Coyle

Lines.Speaker: Old Man Coyle
Lines.Text: Sit down, sit down. The Djinn's in the canyon again. Splits itself into ten and only one of them casts a shadow.

Lines.Speaker: Old Man Coyle
Lines.Text: The one hitting you, usually. Here. Found it in a wyrm track. Don't tell my wife.

Events.Title: Drake on the Rim
Events.Callout: The Quartz Drake is roosting on the rim of Glass Row Canyon. Every gang in the city has a story about this. Make a new one.
Events.Objective: Admire it from far away, or take its plates
Events.Success: The Quartz Drake falls into the canyon. Nobody in Las Veyra will believe you.

Events.Title: Sandstorm Shelter
Events.Callout: Two bikers are sheltering from the sandstorm behind a rock, and the jackals are using the storm for cover.
Events.Objective: Hold the shelter until the storm passes
Events.Success: The storm passes. The bikers say the Quartz Kings will hear what you did.
Events.Failure: The storm passes over an empty shelter.

Events.Title: Quarry Mite Bloom
Events.Callout: The Quartz Badlands Quarry is glittering. That's not the stone. That's a Glass Mite bloom, and something heavy is waking under it.
Events.Success: The bloom is dust, and the Forgewrights will pay for every pinch of it.
